neighbours.label: A vowel-marked ṣād (صَ, with fatha) beginning the word that directly follows النبي ('the Prophet') or رسول الله ('the Messenger of God') mid-sentence in Arabic, such as the blessing صَلَّى or any other صَ-word; not after other people or names, not an unvowelled ص, not other vowelled letters
neighbours.notes: Weak pole (max 11 vs 378 on the + pole; gate-closed leak regime). Probes: النبي/رسول الله + صَلَّى, صَادِقًا, صَبْرًا fire 0.55-0.72; same slot after الملك, الشيخ, الرجل, محمد, or with unvowelled ص, or other vowelled letters (قَ, بَ, مُ) stays below 0.1. Solver leak: the Latin genus 'Lagopus' in a citation (0.45 solo). Top feeders L32/N140+ (reverent honorifics) and L34/N670+ (Hebrew/Arabic word-start letters). Little relation to the French-prose feeder (drop 0.10). Sentences written blind by a label-only author.
